entry.title: RESOLVED: **Summary:** Mitigating elevated error rate with Google Workspace Studio web. **Description:** Mitigation work is currently underway by our engineering team. We do not have an ETA for mitigation at this point. We will provide more information by Friday, 2026-09-25 10:30 PDT. **Symptoms:** Customers may experience an endless loading screen when attempting to access Google Workspace Studio on the web. **Workaround:** None at this time.
entry.summary:
Incident began at 2026-09-25 15:47 and ended at 2026-09-25 16:40 (times are in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)).

Summary:

Mitigated elevated error rate with Google Workspace Studio web.

Description:

The issue with Google Workspace Studio has been resolved for all affected users as of Friday, 2026-09-25 09:40 PDT.

From preliminary analysis, the root cause of the issue is a recent rollout. Our engineering team has rolled back which mitigated the issue.

We thank you for your patience while we worked on resolving the issue.

Symptoms:

Customers may have experienced an endless loading screen when attempting to access Google Workspace Studio on the web.

Workaround: The issue is now mitigated.

Affected products: Google Workspace Studio
